headline: AI Analytics Arms Race Intensifies: OpenAI Enters Enterprise Data Market
bottomLine: OpenAI's new Data Agent signals aggressive AI vendor expansion into enterprise analytics, directly challenging specialized research and institutional data platforms across all sectors and geographies.
keyFindings: OpenAI is moving beyond conversational AI into structured enterprise analytics, positioning Data Agent as a competitive alternative to specialized analytics and research intelligence platforms.
